annotations.title: Save a session as a workflow

description: Saves the open session as a replayable workflow and closes the browser, in the place its browser ran: the user's desktop library or Writ Cloud. Composed functions become callable API functions, declared inputs become its parameters. The answer carries the steps, the inputs and a run_example; the workflow runs at zero AI cost through writ_run_workflow. A save that references something no run could resolve is refused with the reasons, and the browser stays open.

allow_no_data.description: Save a workflow that returns no data, on purpose.
